name: Elastic limit conserves energy
what: No adhesion, no damping, no plasticity: restitution must be 1.

name: Viscoelastic damping calibration
what: Non-adhesive impact must reproduce the material's dry restitution e_dry = 0.85.

name: Plastic restitution (Thornton & Ning 1998)
what: Elastic-plastic impacts must follow the analytic Thornton-Ning restitution.

name: Plasticity with damping
what: With realistic damping (e_dry = 0.7) plastic impacts must give ~ e_TN x e_dry (no damping of a separated contact).

name: Outcome depends only on impact energy
what: Same 1/2 m v^2 with twice the mass must give the same restitution (dimensional analysis of the contact law).

name: Sticking threshold limits
what: Without damping the DEM threshold equals the JKR hysteresis energy estimate; grains stick below / bounce above it; carbon stickier than silica.
value: undamped 3.825 vs JKR 3.827 mm/s; damped silica 6.18 mm/s

name: Free flight with gas drag
what: Residual acceleration + drag vs the exact analytic trajectory over 1 s.

name: Spinning payload frame (Coriolis + centrifugal + drag)
what: Grain trajectory vs a 1e-12-tolerance ODE solution: exact at 1 rpm, 2nd-order convergence at 30x spin.
value: 1 rpm: 0.279 nm; 0.5 Hz: 26.76 um, convergence ratio 4.00

name: Free rotation of an aggregate
what: Spinning linear trimer in vacuum for 5 s: angular momentum conserved, rotational energy bounded (no pumping).

name: Rigid-body collision impulse
what: 200 random oblique impacts on a trimer: post-impact normal velocity = -e v_n exactly; friction stays inside the Coulomb cone.

name: Momentum through sticking and fragmentation
what: Merging three grains into an aggregate and splitting one off conserve linear and angular momentum.

name: Vibrating walls never let grains out
what: 150 grains against 25 um / 200 Hz vibrating walls for 1 s: no grain surface may ever cross a wall.
value: worst penetration = 0.00 nm over 502 wall bounces

name: No missed collisions in a dense gas
what: 300 grains in a 6 mm box for 0.5 s: at the end of every step no two separate bodies may interpenetrate.
value: worst overlap = 0.0e+00 R over 265 grain-grain impacts

name: Long-range electrostatics (Ewald mesh)
what: Short-range pairs + grounded-box particle-mesh field vs Coulomb's law, and the image force near a grounded wall.

name: Contact charging saturates
what: Repeated wall contacts drive the grain to the potential that cancels the work-function difference.

name: Sticking-threshold estimator
what: Logistic fit + bootstrap on synthetic impacts with a known 30 mm/s threshold: unbiased, honest 1-sigma intervals, robust to perfectly separated data.
